thread.title: Screaming Eagles learning from Western Illinois loss - NewsBreak

author: Ronald Clark
title: Screaming Eagles learning from Western Illinois loss - NewsBreak
text:
By Ronald Clark ,
1 hours ago
HENDERSON, Ky (WEHT) – The University of Southern Indiana women’s basketball team suffered their first loss in over two weeks last Friday to Western Illinois tying the two teams for first place in the Ohio Valley Conference standings.
Screaming Eagles head coach Rick Stein said he wouldn’t use the fact that the team played back to back days as an excuse for the loss since Western was doing the same thing after playing Morehead State on the road the day prior. But as the team moves into the second half of the regular season he wants his team to learn from the loss and focus on playing to their standard once again.
Stein said they have to stay committed to playing USI basketball, which includes playing defense for a full 40 minutes and holding teams to under 60 points. He believes if they can achieve these goals they’ll be ready for any team on any given night.
“I think you got to be ready everyday,” Stein said. “You know it’s one of those that man I told our team if you’re going to win in this conference tournament you got to make it there first. But you know regardless you’re going to have to play back-to-back to win. And if you’re a lower seed you’re going to have to do that three, four times back-to-back-to-back. So yea, that’s an experience that will hopefully help us moving forward. Obviously we don’t like to take losses for any reason. We’d rather learn from W’s (wins).”
Southern Indiana will look to bounce back against Lindenwood Thursday, January 29th, at 5:00 p.m. in the Liberty Arena. The game is set to stream on ESPN Plus.
